correctness.rationale: The proof reduces repeated pendant twins exactly, proves a universal bipartite lower bound of min{4, side sizes}, and supplies matching side and four-extreme-vertex constructions after trimming. Boundary cases including stars, complete bipartite graphs, K2, and the three-by-three half graph are covered by the same argument. The executable verifier exhaustively agrees on all 511 canonical connected chain profiles of total order at most 10; this computation is corroborative rather than a substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: The formula collapses a potentially long chain-block description to four natural statistics: two side sizes and two leaf-twin excesses. It gives an immediate exact algorithm, explains the four-guard threshold structurally through a universal bipartite lower bound, and resolves small-side instances omitted by the closest four-extreme-vertex routine. This is a natural complete invariant for a standard graph class rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
